description: Seed-1 weights-only single-Skiing 1M adaptations from completed 20M LSTM/GRU and a 19.45M GaWF snapshot, using one full18-to-9 mapping and a 450-step no-course-progress truncation.
notes: LSTM/GaWF formal code uses read-only snapshot 3548970e and GRU uses read-only snapshot 5ad4de5f, both based on local 11cac19; the dirty SJC main checkout and both active Amarel code snapshots remain unchanged.

Every unit is a derived single-task adaptation: only model weights load from its completed 20M seed1 final state_dict; optimizer, replay, global step, RNG trajectory, epsilon, and LR schedule start fresh.

GRU seed1 started from the completed 20M final state already present in the isolated SJC input leaf. LSTM seed1 uses the completed 20M final state copied read-only from Amarel (SHA256 0c06301675543c5c559951d4c42e96082989ea1dbcab3057d7189c6a2b268e76).

GaWF seed1 intentionally uses only model weights extracted from a stable copied 19,450,000-step resumable checkpoint: raw SHA256 529d7d0bca6c2161fb731b6ecba6f6ddc22de4c84e9aead83c42a5208a4517d8 and extracted model SHA256 1aa6217322270bf62382912caaecaa1f28d6c7846bb3e2ea676420ed82abfcd8. Optimizer, replay, counters, RNG trajectory, epsilon, and LR schedule are not loaded.

LSTM remains on SJC GPU0. After GRU completed and released GPU1, GaWF was checkpointed at adaptation step 98,884 (replay_size 98,884) and resumed from the same result leaf on GPU1 with resume_count=1; optimizer, replay, counters, RNG, epsilon, and LR state were preserved by the resumable checkpoint.
All result leaves share the single required parent formal_20m_4mpertask_raw_seeds; no parallel result parent is used.

The completed GRU/LSTM 1M units remain the finalized scope of this manifest. The still-running GaWF unit was transferred without changing its result leaf to rl-atari-skiing-full18-stall-actionfix-v1-total2m-lstm-gru-gawf-s1 when its authorized target increased to 2M; that new manifest is its sole active fact source.
